text:
yara: reserving maintenance slot ms-982 for cross-tenant schema add + small index backfill. start 2026-04-12T01:30:00Z. window=50m. plan: DDL on leader only, then ripple backfills in 4 waves, runtime pin v2.16.2.

deploybot: slot ms-982 created. start=2026-04-12T01:30:00Z window=50m owner=@yara holdpoints=[preflight, canary-check] autopause=12m

ben-oncall: quick preflight: smoke migration in staging, sample pg_locks snapshot, ensure replica lag alert at 40s. canary tenants = small-tenant-3/4, backfill rate 750/s.

olga: adding guardrails: abort if deadlocks >1 in 10m or table-locks >4s on >2 hosts. also require deploybot ACK for canary-check continue.

yara: short rollback runbook (ops TLDR):
```
1) stop backfill: `./bin/migctl stop --slot ms-982`
2) enable write block: `ffctl enable tenant_schema_write_block`
3) unpin runtime: `infractl unpin api v2.16.2 --force`
4) run revert DDL: `psql -f revert/ms-982-undo.sql`
5) notify #oncall and open incident if replication > 90s
```

deploybot: holdpoint created: ms-982.preflight. waiting for @ben-oncall :white_check_mark:. react to proceed.

ben-oncall: preflight smoke OK. locks sample low, staging backfill ran at 700/s with no errors. :white_check_mark:

olga: canary started. wave=1/5 targets=[st-3,st-4] workers=5 rate=750. I'll watch pg_stat_activity.

deploybot: canary wave complete. metrics: errors=0.04% replication_peak=28s latency+1ms. vote CONTINUE or ABORT.

ben-oncall: +1 continue. keep holdpoint until T+10m for observation.

olga: starting sequential waves. lowering batch size for wave 3 due to CPU.

yara: small note: if unpin blocks due to scheduler lease we should first scale up read replicas x1 and flip route policy to read-fallback to drain writes before unpin.

deploybot: wave=3/5 in progress. queued=9 workers=6

ben-oncall: noticed a single 6s lock on shard-b during wave 3, under threshold. continuing but keeping stricter alerting.

olga: observed replication lag peek at 48s on replica-2 during wave 4. triggering manual watch. if it crosses 60s we abort and run rollback steps.

yara: holding final go for 5m observation, will post release-note snippet after window ends.

deploybot: full-window complete. status=success. errors aggregate=0.18% p99+2ms. closing slot ms-982. artifacts: deploybot.audit=ddb-archive-3419001234, logs uploaded to s3://redwood-runs/ms-982/.

ben-oncall: capturing post-run artifacts: pg_locks snapshots, backfill logs, replication timeline. will attach to the rollout ticket.

yara: thanks team — will add a quick postmortem checklist if anything to followup. closing thread. :rocket:
